title: Devastating Brooklyn Building Collapse Claims 8 Lives, Injures 17 in Flatbush
snippet: A three-story apartment building in Brooklyn's Flatbush neighborhood collapsed into a neighboring construction site, leaving eight dead and at least 17 injured as search-and-rescue teams work tirelessly through the rubble.
content:
FLATBUSH, Brooklyn — A terrifying scene unfolded in Brooklyn on Wednesday afternoon when a three-story residential building suddenly collapsed into an adjacent excavation site, killing eight people and injuring at least 17 others in the heart of Flatbush.

Emergency crews rushed to the scene within a minute of receiving 911 calls around 4:00 p.m. ET. Nearly 250 first responders worked through the night under extremely hazardous conditions, tunneling through piles of twisted metal and concrete in search of survivors buried in structural voids.

A Race Against Time Amid Treacherous Conditions

At least seven children and three FDNY firefighters were among those transported to area hospitals, with four victims listed in critical condition. Authorities confirmed two deaths on Wednesday evening, with six more victims discovered overnight as teams methodically sifted through the wreckage.

Amid the overwhelming heartbreak, moments of profound relief emerged. A six-month pregnant woman was miraculously pulled from the debris alive after being trapped for more than two hours. Her frantic husband, who had been waiting nearby in anguish, expressed overwhelming gratitude as paramedics wheeled her to safety.

"She is alive. She is still alive. I'm very happy," he told reporters, praising the emergency crews on site.

Distress and Escape

Surrounding residents described sudden chaos as the 1930s four-unit structure crumpled without warning. One father recalled getting a frantic call from his wife as debris pinned her down inside their apartment alongside their two young children, ages 7 and 2. She was screaming for help before the line suddenly went dead. Thankfully, first responders were able to rescue all three family members safely.

The force of the collapse tore away the side of an adjacent building, exposing the exposed interiors of neighboring apartments to the open air.

Investigation and Ongoing Operations

City officials said active excavation work was being conducted in the neighboring lot at the time of the collapse. While the exact cause remains under investigation, FDNY Commissioner Lillian Bonsignore warned that the rescue operation would be prolonged and extremely delicate.

"Collapse operations are extremely dangerous," Bonsignore said. "Every move is choreographed and critically important to patient outcomes and member safety. Members have been working methodically and haven't stopped since they arrived."

New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani extended his deep condolences to the affected families and praised the bravery of first responders on Thursday morning. "There are no words for a loss of this magnitude," Mamdani said in a statement. "My heart is with the families and loved ones of those we have lost, those who are injured, and everyone grieving today."
